CardDescription.zh:
生长在松木林隙中；需要高酸度和低到中等湿度。冬季外低养分下产量最高。

有助于健康，同时减少呼吸道感染和压力。
CardDescription.en:
Found in pine clearings; needs high acidity and low to mid hydration. Produces the most yield on low nutrients outside of winter.

Boosts wellbeing, while reducing respiratory infections and stress.
CardDescription.ja: 松の空き地に生育する。高い酸性度と低〜中程度の水分量を必要とする。冬以外では、栄養度が低いほど収穫量が最大になる。健康度を高め、呼吸器感染症とストレスを軽減する。

CardHelpSection.zh: 产地：松木林隙，夏季盛开。 需求：高等酸度，低到中等湿度和任意土质。冬季外低养分下产量最高。 效果：蜜源、动物饲料、覆土作物。（花：温和的兴奋剂、祛痰药）
CardHelpSection.en: Found: Pine Clearings. Blooms in Summer. Growth Needs: High Acidity, Low to Mid Hydration and Any Structure. Produces the most yield on Low Nutrients outside of Winter. Benefits: Nectariferous, Animal Feed, Cover Crop, (Flowers: Mild Stimulant, Expectorant)
CardHelpSection.ja: Found: Pine Clearings. Blooms in Summer. Growth Needs: High Acidity, Low to Mid Hydration and Any Structure. Produces the most yield on Low Nutrients outside of Winter. Benefits: Nectariferous, Animal Feed, Cover Crop, (Flowers: Mild Stimulant, Expectorant)
